Output: 1. Policy reform and implementation framework is established to carry out the proposed reforms. 2. Khadi is effectively promoted and marketed to ensure commercial viability as well as generate market demand for khadi. 3. Reduce the working capital blocked in the production value chain and enhance capacity utilization of CSPs. 4. Institutional reforms are implemented to restructure KVIC, revitalize khadi institutions and develop synergies between Khadi and traditional village industries. Indicator: 1.Khadi reform package implemented by December 2017 Progress/Status: • 2027 working institutions have been registered for Khadi Mark, with majority of them actually implementing same. • DRA implementation initiated in around 91 Khadi Institutions out of the 400 Khadi Institutions. Data Source: Independent assessment of program implementation and impact; KVIC annual report. Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Policy reform and implementation framework is established to carry out the proposed reforms. 2. Khadi is effectively promoted and marketed to ensure commercial viability as well as generate market demand for khadi. 3. Reduce the working capital blocked in the production value chain and enhance capacity utilization of CSPs. 4. Institutional reforms are implemented to restructure KVIC, revitalize khadi institutions and develop synergies between Khadi and traditional village industries. Indicator: 2. Increase in sales by 40% Progress/Status: • Khadi Sector Sales as on 2014-15 stood at INR 1.17 billion (increase of 35%) • A policy initiative has been undertaken by KVIC by converging all key marketing initiatives for KVI products under “Market Promotion and Development Assistance” in 2016 which is under implementation. • Consumer Survey for Khadi has been initiated, and 2 more market research studies are expected to be launched in February 2016. Data Source: KVIC annual report. Official gazette/relevant government notifications. Baseline year: 2009 Baseline value: INR8.67 billion Baseline year: 2009 Baseline value: INR8.67 billion Target year: 2017 Target value: INR12 billion

Output: 1. Policy reform and implementation framework is established to carry out the proposed reforms. 2. Khadi is effectively promoted and marketed to ensure commercial viability as well as generate market demand for khadi. 3. Reduce the working capital blocked in the production value chain and enhance capacity utilization of CSPs. 4. Institutional reforms are implemented to restructure KVIC, revitalize khadi institutions and develop synergies between Khadi and traditional village industries. Indicator: 4(a). The comprehensive reform plan is implemented for 400 eligible khadi institutions. 4(b). IT and e-governance systems and practices by KVIC are strengthened. 4(c). Traditional village industries implement the cluster development strategy. Progress/Status: • DRA implementation initiated in around 91 Khadi Institutions out of the 400 Khadi Institutions. • MIS has been implemented in 110 KIs, • Vendor procurement completed in January 2016 for developing and deploying eGovernance solution
• Under the VI component, out of 5 clusters to be implemented under 5 different VI, currently, implementation of clusters under Beekeeping VI is in progress, while cluster under Food Processing will be implemented after receipt of funds. DPR has been prepared for Leather Cluster and sanction of the same is awaited. KVIC is in process of identifying new VIs for Herbal cluster. Data Source: KVIC annual report. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y
Revitalized KVI subsector provides sustainable employment to artisans with higher earnings.

At least 12% increase in number of artisan employed by khadi institutions by 2017 Progress/Status: Number of artisans engaged as on 2014-15 is 1.11 million (increase of 12.7%). Data Source: KVIC annual reports. Baseline value: 0.98 million

At least 20% increase in the khadi subsector earnings by 2017. Progress/Status: Khadi sector earning as on 2014-15 is 4.83 billion (increase of 13.6%). Data Source: Implementation reports by EA. Government statistics (India's Ministry of Statistics and Program Implementation). Baseline value: INR4.25 billion
